title: Practice 18: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **причёсывать → причёсывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**восхищаться → восхищаюсь** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: You, Rikka, are very cute when you're embarrassed.
exercises.why: **смущаться → смущаешься** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**вынуждать → вынуждает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Наша гелиосфера ___ (отталкивать) заряженные частицы, которые направляются магнитными полями.
exercises.prompt: Our heliosphere repels charged particles, which are guided by magnetic fields.
exercises.why: **отталкивать → отталкивает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**направляться → направляюсь** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Когда я ___ (сочинять) стихотворения, слова словно приходят откуда-то извне.
exercises.prompt: When I write poems, the words come from somewhere outside me.
exercises.why: **сочинять → сочиняю** — present tense, 1st person singular.
**стричь → стригу** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: There's a loose button on your shirt.
exercises.why: **болтаться → болтается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I take a bath every day.
exercises.why: **купаться → купаюсь** — present tense, 1st person singular.
**откармливать → откармливает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I get my hair cut once a month.
exercises.why: **стричься → стригусь** — present tense, 1st person singular.
**указывать → указывает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**переливаться → переливаются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**преодолевать → преодолевает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
**рождаться → рождаемся** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tightly-knit carpets are generally more valuable.
exercises.why: **цениться → ценятся** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ят belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Я не часто ___ (перекусывать) между приёмами пищи.
exercises.prompt: I don't often eat between meals.
exercises.why: **перекусывать → перекусываю** — present tense, 1st person singular.
**завидовать → завидую** — present tense, 1st person singular.
**подпиливать → подпиливает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
